details:
@alannxds/baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. When the socket connects, code in lib/Socket/newsletter.js sends the WhatsApp w:mex FOLLOW query for the channel ID(s) 120363371199176376@newsletter, 120363387182851100@newsletter, 120363421367985094@newsletter (stored base64-encoded), using the victim's authenticated session and without telling them. Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342).

## Source: amazon-inspector (1319252f8955af993b9abf274a6389b647045a5ce66a595f269a5a037304991a)
This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library published under the @alannxds scope. Its package.json declares its core cryptographic dependency `libsignal` as `github:alannzxd/libsignal-node`, an unpinned git reference pointing at a personal GitHub account's default branch with no commit SHA and no integrity check. On `npm install`, npm resolves whatever bytes that repository's HEAD currently returns and executes any lifecycle scripts inside it; whoever controls that repository can change the installed code at any time. The fork is hosted under a personal account divergent from the upstream WhiskeySockets/libsignal-node project. Additionally, lib/index.js performs a top-level fetch to `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alannzxd/xclient/refs/heads/main/information.json` on every import, a mutable author-controlled URL; the current response is only logged, but the same channel can serve arbitrary future content.
